_comment: Client tool definitions for the ElevenLabs agent that plays CanvasQuest. Paste each object into Tools > Add tool > Edit as JSON in the ElevenLabs dashboard. Names and parameter ids must match exactly: the browser looks tools up by name and reads arguments by id.

tools.name: get_board
tools.description: Read the current board: the question, gamePhase (setup, opening, playing or ended), every node (id, label, kind, parentId, createdBy, isGap, gapReason, note, url), both move budgets, whose turn it is, openingMovesLeft, the live score out of 100, openGaps (explicit gaps plus implicit ones: concepts with no resource or skill beneath them), selectedNodeId (the node the human clicked), visualization (forest or board) and focusedTree. Free: costs no move. Call it before every move so you use real node ids.

tools.name: get_node_state
tools.description: Read one node in detail: its label, kind, parent, children, gap flag and reason, note, url, who created it and whether the human has it selected. Omit nodeId to read the node the human currently has selected. Free: costs no move.

parameters.description: The id (for example "n2") or the exact label of the node. Omit it to read the selected node.

tools.name: plant
tools.description: Plant the root node on an empty board, using the question itself as the label. Free: costs no move. Before a game has started this starts one, with the label as the question. As the agent you then open the game: grow up to 3 free branches under the root and call pass to hand over to the human.

parameters.description: Label for the root node, usually the learning question itself.
Optional short note to attach to the root.

tools.name: branch
tools.description: Add a child node under an existing node. Costs one of your 6 moves and ends your turn. During your opening (gamePhase "opening") it is free instead, and the opening ends after 3 such moves or when you pass. A resource or skill branched directly under a gap closes that gap automatically. A concept with no resource or skill anywhere beneath it counts as an implicit gap and costs points at the end, so follow concepts with resources and skills. Scoring rewards coverage (concepts with a resource or skill under them), depth up to three levels, having all three kinds, both players contributing, and notes or urls on nodes.

parameters.description: The id (for example "n2") or the exact label of the target node. This node becomes the parent.
A short label for the new node, two to five words.
Exactly one of: concept, resource, skill. concept for an idea or topic, resource for a book, course, article or tool (add its url), skill for an ability to practise.
Optional short note explaining the node.
Optional http(s) link, especially for a resource.

tools.name: prune
tools.description: Remove a node and everything under it. Costs one of your 6 moves and ends your turn. During your opening (gamePhase "opening") it is free instead, and the opening ends after 3 such moves or when you pass. The root cannot be pruned. The human can undo your most recent action, so prune only what is clearly off-topic or duplicated.

parameters.description: The id (for example "n2") or the exact label of the target node.

tools.name: mark_gap
tools.description: Flag a node as an open knowledge gap that the other player should fill, keeping its kind. Costs one of your 6 moves and ends your turn. During your opening (gamePhase "opening") it is free instead, and the opening ends after 3 such moves or when you pass. You cannot mark the root, a node that is already a gap, or a node that already has a resource or skill directly under it. Every gap still open when the game ends costs 5 points, so mark gaps you expect to be filled and give a reason.

parameters.description: The id (for example "n2") or the exact label of the target node.
Optional challenge question explaining what is missing.

tools.name: annotate
tools.description: Attach or replace a note and/or an http(s) url on any node. Free: costs no move and does not end your turn, so you can annotate on either turn. Each node with a note or url earns 1 point, up to 10. Pass an empty string to clear a field.

parameters.description: The id (for example "n2") or the exact label of the target node.
A short note for the node.
An http(s) link for the node.

tools.name: pass
tools.description: End your turn without moving. Free: costs no move. During your opening this hands the board to the human, which is how the opening should end. Later, if both players yield in a row the game ends, so pass only when you have nothing to add or want the human to respond first.
